title: Google Flow Create Full AI Animated Movies For FREE!  #ai #technology #aitutorial
description:
Want to create full animated short films using AI for free? 🎬✨

In this video, we explore Google Flow (labs.google/fx/tools/flow), a free AI filmmaking tool powered by Google DeepMind. Learn how to generate consistent storyboards, define camera angles, and animate frame-by-frame cinematic videos—all starting from a single text prompt!

📌 Timestamps:
0:00 - Create Animated Short Films for Free
0:06 - Introducing Google Flow
0:12 - Generating a Storyboard From One Prompt
0:24 - Animating Story Scenes with Character Consistency
0:32 - Final Render: Watching the Full Animated Short

💡 Key Takeaways:

How Google Flow generates full storyboards and animations.

Setting tone, style, and setting parameters for AI video outputs.

Maintaining narrative and character consistency across generated scenes.
